Test for invoice-paid-date → income consolidation was SKIPPED — no cash accounts exist in current DB. The analytics code path consolidating subscriber_invoices.paid_date into income could not be validated end-to-end; only contract was validated.

Frontend testing was inconclusive on automation, but FinanceiroPanelExt.js shows CashFlowTab renders <AnalyticsChart /> at line ~360 BEFORE the BarChart (verified by file inspection).

issues: Recharts emits 'width(-1) height(-1) should be > 0' warning during initial render — harmless but indicates a brief render where ResponsiveContainer parent has 0 dimensions. Consider min-height on parent flex container.

critical_code_review_comments: rate_limit.py headers_enabled=False — appropriate to avoid slowapi response-mutation conflicts with FastAPI dict returns.
rate_limit.py uses memory:// storage — per-pod scope. In multi-pod prod, use redis:// to share counters.

financeiro_analytics.py _range_for() uses days=180/365 instead of calendar months/years — leads to off-by-one in bucket count (6-8 instead of strict 7 for 6m/month). Functional but cosmetically imprecise.

financeiro_analytics.py: regularity threshold cv<25 'regular' uses statistics.pstdev — for very small N, std is artificially low; could mis-classify low-sample series as 'regular'. Consider requiring N>=3 before classifying.
